public_auto_str_83:
Operation Guide
Reload Configuration: Smoothly loads the latest configuration. The process re-reads the configuration without disconnecting existing connections, ensuring zero business disruption. Recommended for use after making routine configuration changes.
Restart Service: Forcibly terminates and restarts all processes. This will cause in-progress requests (such as order submissions and file uploads) to be instantly interrupted and result in a 502 error. Use only in extremely rare cases when recovering from exceptions.
